2.problem: Four identical spherical cows, each of radius 17 meters, are arranged in a tetrahedral pyramid (their centers are the vertices of a regular tetrahedron, and each one is tangent to the other three). The pyramid of cows is put on the ground, with three of them laying on it. What is the distance between the ground and the top of the topmost cow?
